note: Backtest of a heuristic-0.1-style projection (fixture-adjusted, but pre-DEFCON — that scoring is new for 2025/26). Rank correlation = how well a method orders players by points (higher better); MAE = average points error (lower better); lift = avg actual points of the top-20% vs bottom-20% projected. FPL's own xP is the benchmark to beat — the gap is why the trained model (Phase 2) is the priority.
